title: Complete BACKHAUL lifecycle coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix BACKHAUL configuration generation, authentication/transport validation, process lifecycle, reconnect behavior, and secret redaction.
acceptanceCriteria: BACKHAUL config rejects unsupported/invalid transport and auth inputs with schema errors
Generated client/server TOML is deterministic and contains no unintended secret leakage in logs or diagnostics
Start, stop, restart, reconnect, process failure, and cleanup paths have focused tests
A missing binary produces an actionable error rather than a false running state

steps.details: Extend the existing optimization harness with BACKHAUL valid/invalid config, deterministic output, and lifecycle test doubles before changing production code.
Read `packages/tunnel-core/src/config/backhaul.ts`, engine planner, process runner, and existing method tests; identify only evidence-backed gaps.
Apply the smallest compatibility-preserving correction to config/lifecycle handling and add sanitized failure events.
Run the focused tests, full custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record a real-binary limitation separately if no safe binary is available.

technicalNotes: Do not add a new method or rewrite the protocol. Real tunnel traffic requires the approved VPS fixture.
